name: What is the typical process for designing and building a Junior ADU with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and building a Junior ADU with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for developing a Junior ADU begins with a comprehensive consultation to understand your vision and the existing space. We then move into design planning, which includes CAD-supported layouts to visualize the transformation, followed by permit coordination. Construction involves integrating the new living area with your home's existing structure, and we manage all phases from demolition to final walkthrough. Throughout this managed process, AKN Design Group provides a single point of coordination, ensuring clear communication and a seamless project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, CAD-supported design, permit coordination, construction, and a final walkthrough, all managed by one team.
